name: Mary C. Meier

updates.occupation: bookkeeper; saleswoman in a retail clothing store (1950)

residences.note: Single, 51. Living with her father Henry J., 83, and mother Anna, 82.

bioAdditions: Mary never married. She was still at 16 Barney Street with her elderly parents in the 1950 census, working as a saleswoman in a retail clothing store (S2). The 1962 Pennsylvania death index has 'MEIER MARY C, 65, WLKS BRE, county 40, died 02/10/62, file 016450' (S1). This confirms the FamilySearch date of 10 Feb 1962. She was buried at St Mary's, Hanover Township (S3).
